'''Chaz''' (Japanese: '''エイジ''' ''Eiji'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. He made his main appearance in ''[[AG013|All Things Bright and Beautifly!]]''.

Chaz is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who entered the [[Rustboro City]] [[Pokémon Contest]] alongside his friend and rival, [[Janet]]. In the end, he and Janet both made it to the final round. Chaz used his {{p|Venomoth}} against her {{p|Beautifly}}, but ended up losing to her.

Upon finding out {{Ash}}'s intention to battle the [[Rustboro Gym]] with his {{AP|Pikachu}}, Chaz instructed Ash to teach Pikachu the [[move]] {{m|Iron Tail}} with the help of his {{p|Sentret}} in order to overcome [[Roxanne]]'s {{type|Rock}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}.

Chaz also had a cameo in ''[[AG122|Deceit and Assist]]'', watching {{an|May}} compete in the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]. He appears to know [[Timmy Grimm]] from [[Verdanturf Town]], as he was seen watching the Grand Festival with him.
